body.name: Regular interior multinomial region
body.construction: \(\Theta_{\mathrm{reg}}(\delta)=\{\vartheta: \vartheta_{xzy}\geq\delta\text{ for every }x\in\mathcal X,z\in\mathcal Z,y\in\mathcal Y,\text{ and for every }t\in\mathcal T_0\text{ the associated perspective SOCP has a feasible array with every nonredundant response-mass and odds-face inequality slack by at least }\delta\}\).
